Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation of Q2 FY 2026-27 Financial Results Group Conference Call  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule Ill of SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that a group conference 
call will be held on Wednesday, 4th November 2026 at 5.30 pm to discuss the Financial Results 
for the quarter and six months ended 30th September 2026. We are enclosing herewith the 
invitation to the call which contains the joining and contact details. 
 
You are requested to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly, 
For JSW Dulux Limited 
(Formerly Akzo Nobel India Limited) 
 
 
 
Rajiv L. Jha  
General Counsel & Company Secretary  
 
Encl: as above. 
Rajiv
